subject: Request: KMS key-wrapping attestation + Art.30 excerpt for DPIA
messages:
From: Alice Benton <alice.benton@greenharbor.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: dpo@greenharbor.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 14:22:00 +0000
Subject: DPIA support: KMS key wrapping attestation + Art.30 excerpt

Marcus —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As part of our DPIA and vendor security review we need a few items to close our internal checklist:

1) A signed attestation that Redwood uses customer-key-wrapping (KMIP-compatible) with customer-controlled KEKs where applicable, and details on whether keys are ever exported or escrowed by Redwood. A short PDF we can attach to our DPIA is ideal.

2) An excerpt from your Article 30 register showing the processing activities relevant to our use case (text generation, logs, embeddings). We typically ask for a CSV with columns: activity_id, purpose, categories_of_data, recipients, retention_period.

3) A sample of access logs (anonymized) for the last 90 days showing admin/key-access events and the related audit trail. If full logs are not shareable, a zipped sample with redacted PII is fine.

Can you also confirm whether transfer safeguards (SCCs + additional technical measures) are documented in the same packet or provided separately?

We are aiming to present to our DPO on Friday, so if you can get the attestation and Art.30 excerpt this week that would be great.

Thanks,
Alice Benton
Senior Security Manager — Green Harbor Bank
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: Alice Benton <alice.benton@greenharbor.com>, dpo@greenharbor.com
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: DPIA support: KMS key wrapping attestation + Art.30 excerpt

Folks — putting this thread in your inbox. Alice from Green Harbor is requesting three deliverables for their DPIA: a KMS key-wrapping attestation PDF, an Article 30 register excerpt for their processing scope, and a 90-day access-log sample (redacted). They also asked where SCCs and transfer mitigations are documented.

Marissa — can you draft the KMS attestation (short, signed) that states our policy on customer KEKs, key export/escrow stance, and the operational controls around key rotation and HSM usage? If possible, include the HSM provider and FIPS level. Target: initial draft by Thu EOD.

Irene — can you pull a filtered Art.30 CSV for activities matching: text-generation API, embedding computation, and request/trace logs? Please include retention periods and subprocessors for each line. If there are any entries that reference cross-border transfers, flag them so we can attach SCC references. Target: Fri morning.

On logs: we should avoid sending raw PII. Marissa/Infra/Security — recommend preparing a zipped sample containing: (a) access-log-sample-202703.csv with admin actions against KMS and service accounts (redacted IDs), (b) a short readme describing what was redacted and the sampling method. Keep sample <50MB.

Alice/dpo@greenharbor.com — we will provide an initial packet and a signed attestation PDF. Can we get confirmation if Green Harbor requires a notarized signature or if a DocuSign-signed PDF is sufficient? We have a DocuSign flow and can route it to your DPO.

I'll coordinate delivery and will mark attachments in the final packet.

Thanks — Marcus
VP, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: Alice Benton <alice.benton@greenharbor.com>, dpo@greenharbor.com
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: DPIA support: KMS key wrapping attestation + Art.30 excerpt

Marcus / Irene — draft attached (kms-key-wrapping-attestation.pdf) and I prepared the sample logs bundle (access-log-sample-202703.zip). Notes:

- Attestation: states Redwood supports customer-managed KEKs via KMIP or customer-supplied wrapped keys, we do not escrow customer raw keys, keys used for production inference are stored in HSMs (AWS CloudHSM / FIPS 140-2 Level 3 equivalent), and we rotate intermediate wrapping keys per our key policy. Language: short, suitable for inclusion in a DPIA.

- Art.30 excerpt: Irene — I pre-filtered scopes and exported lines to art30-register-excerpt.csv (attached). I kept the columns Alice requested. Irene, please verify subprocessor names and retention columns before we send.

- Logs: access-log-sample-202703.zip contains a 90-day sample for March showing admin KMS operations and service-account access with redacted principal IDs (format readme included). Size is 12MB.

Next steps: Irene, can you confirm subprocessor entries and add SCC reference links where necessary? Also confirm whether we should include the 'additional technical measures' appendix.

Marissa Cole
Senior Security Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Alice Benton <alice.benton@greenharbor.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: dpo@greenharbor.com, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: DPIA support: KMS key wrapping attestation + Art.30 excerpt

Marissa / Marcus — thanks, this looks good and the level of detail in the attestation is exactly what we need. A few quick follow-ups before I sign off with the DPO: 

• DocuSign: DocuSign is fine — please send the envelope to dpo@greenharbor.com and cc me.
• SCCs & transfers: Irene, if you can add links to the standard SCCs we use plus a short bullet list of additional technical measures (TLS ciphers, in-flight encryption, prefix caching isolation) that would close the transfer question.
• Sampling notes: the readme is helpful; please confirm the sampling method (random by request id vs. time-window) and whether logs include any ephemeral developer IDs — we want to ensure our review covers impersonation/privilege escalation traces.

If you can get the DocuSign link and an updated Art.30 with SCC links by EOD today, we can close this on our side. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Alice Benton
Senior Security Manager — Green Harbor Bank
